cases.about: The shop answers 502 and starts an outage; the database port, down since 09:45, is back after 30 minutes; the bakery is up but slow; the states are carried forward.
cases.notebook:
- https://shop.example/ up
- db1:5432 down since 09:45
- https://bakery.example/ up

call.command: for t in https://shop.example/ db1:5432 https://bakery.example/; do case "$t" in http*) echo "$t $(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code} %{time_total}' --max-time 10 "$t" 2>&1)";; *) h=${t%:*}; p=${t##*:}; nc -z -w 5 "$h" "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "$t open" || echo "$t closed";; esac; done
